summary: LLM API pricing in late 2026 spans a wide range, from sub-$0.20 per million input tokens for lightweight models to $10+ for flagship frontier models, with output tokens typically priced 4-5x higher than input. Prompt caching discounts (often 75-90% off input) and batch processing (usually 50% off) have become standard cost-reduction levers across all major vendors. Note that the live research data references several newer model families (GPT-6, Claude Opus 5.x, Gemini 3.x/4) that postdate the specific models requested; the table below reflects confirmed published pricing for the publicly available models with verifiable official pricing pages.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.notes: Batch API offers 50% discount. Prompt caching provides 50% off cached input tokens. Flagship multimodal model.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.notes: Prompt caching reduces cached reads to ~$0.30/1M (90% off); cache writes cost more. Batch API offers 50% discount.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.notes: Free tier available with content used for product improvement. Context caching discount applies. Output price includes thinking tokens. Batch requests half price.

models.name: GPT-4o mini
models.notes: Low-cost small model. Batch API offers 50% discount. Prompt caching provides 50% off cached input.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.notes: Tiered pricing: higher rates apply for prompts over 200K tokens ($2.50 input / $15 output). Free tier available with data usage. Batch requests half price.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.notes: Fast, low-cost model. Prompt caching reduces cached reads ~90%. Batch API offers 50% discount.

models.name: o4-mini
models.notes: Reasoning model; output includes reasoning tokens. Batch API offers 50% discount. Prompt caching available.

models.name: o3
models.notes: Advanced reasoning model following price reductions in 2025. Output includes reasoning tokens. Batch API 50% discount.

models.name: Claude Opus 4.8
models.notes: Most capable Claude model; premium pricing. Prompt caching cached reads ~90% off. Batch API offers 50% discount.

models.name: Grok 4
models.notes: xAI flagship model. Higher rates apply for context beyond 128K tokens. Prompt caching available.

models.name: Mistral Large
models.notes: Free tier via La Plateforme with rate limits. Batch API offers ~50% discount.

models.name: Mistral Small
models.notes: Low-cost model. Free tier available with rate limits. Batch API discount available.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B (Groq)
models.notes: Hosted via Groq's ultra-fast LPU inference. Free tier with rate limits available. Open-weight Meta model.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B (Together AI)
models.notes: Hosted open-weight model. Free trial credits for new accounts. Dedicated endpoints available.

models.name: Llama 3.1 405B (Fireworks)
models.notes: Largest open-weight Llama model hosted on Fireworks. Free trial credits available. Serverless pricing.

models.name: Command R+
models.notes: Optimized for RAG and tool use. Free trial API keys with rate limits available.
